full_name: Imani Perry | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor Harvard University
bio: Imani Perry is the author of nine books, including the National Book Award–winning title South to America: A Journey Below the Mason-Dixon to Understand the Soul of a Nation (Ecco, 2022). She is a 2023 MacArthur Fellow, and her latest book, Black in Blues: How a Color Tells the Story of My People (Ecco, 2025), was published in January.
